Produce **Sprint S16 Part B — Persona Mode Switcher** design spec for InkOS.

**Plan:** `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/giggly-kindling-bee.md` (Part B section). Read it end-to-end — the plan already has the mode taxonomy, access rules, cookie strategy, and keyboard shortcuts locked. Your job is to fill in visual + interaction details.

**Context:**
- S13-S15 shipped nav consolidation + Studio/Location switchers using the `lib/context/active-*.ts` + cookie pattern
- ModeSwitcher should mirror that pattern exactly — don't invent new state mechanisms
- Existing switcher components: `components/shared/StudioSwitcher.tsx`, `components/shared/LocationSwitcher.tsx` — same visual DNA

**Save spec to** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/.handoffs/vega-sprint-16b-spec.md`:

## 1. ModeSwitcher visual

Pick ONE of these:
- **Segmented control** (3 attached buttons, bg-muted container, active = bg-background + shadow-soft)
- **Tabs** (underline style)
- **Pill dropdown** (like StudioSwitcher — single trigger + list)

Trade-off:
- Segmented is most scannable (user always sees all 3 modes)
- Dropdown saves space (fits in collapsed sidebar)

Recommendation: **segmented control** for expanded sidebar, **icon-only stacked buttons** (vertical) for collapsed sidebar.

Spec the exact dimensions:
- Expanded: height 32px, full width of sidebar minus 16px padding, gap 2px between segments
- Collapsed: 3 icon buttons stacked vertically, each 40×40, centered
- Icons: `CalendarCheck` (Operate), `Briefcase` (Manage), `Cog` (Configure) — from lucide
- Label typography: 12/500
- Active: `bg-primary/10 text-primary font-semibold`
- Inactive: `text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground`
- Disabled (role doesn't have access): not rendered at all

## 2. Placement

Top of `AppSidebar.tsx`. Order:
1. Studio logo + name (existing `SidebarHeader`)
2. StudioSwitcher (existing, if multi-studio)
3. **ModeSwitcher (NEW)** — 12px margin above, 16px margin below
4. SidebarContent (existing nav groups)

When collapsed: ModeSwitcher becomes icon stack, no margins different from other sidebar items.

## 3. Interaction

- Click a mode → POST `/api/context/set-mode` → await → `router.refresh()` (reuses StudioSwitcher pattern)
- Pending state: segment briefly shows spinner, other segments go `opacity-60`
- Failure: toast "Couldn't switch mode. Try again." — reuses `sonner` + existing pattern
- Keyboard: `G` then `O`/`M`/`C` (extend `G_CHORD_MAP` in `AppHeader.tsx` — spec exact chord behavior, noting it posts to API instead of pushing a route)
- `aria-label="Switch mode"` on segmented container
- Each button: `aria-pressed={active}` + descriptive label

## 4. MobileNav mode tabs

In the `MobileNav` sheet, add mode tabs AT TOP (before user avatar block):
- Horizontal segmented, full width, 44px touch height
- Same 3 icons + labels
- Same click behavior — POST set-mode → refresh
- Closes sheet after mode change (existing auto-close on route change doesn't fire because no route change happens — explicitly call `setOpen(false)` on success)

## 5. Empty state (no-op modes)

If user has `allowedModes.length === 1` (artist, guest_artist): ModeSwitcher returns `null` — don't render anything, don't reserve space.

If user has 2 modes (receptionist → Operate + Manage): show 2-button segmented, no Configure button.

## 6. Default mode resolution

Server-side in `getActiveMode(role)`:
- If cookie set AND in allowedModes → use cookie
- Else → default per role (artist/guest_artist/receptionist → 'operate', admin/owner → 'manage')

Client must NEVER drive this — respect server resolution.

## 7. `<ModeSwitcher>` prop contract

```tsx
<ModeSwitcher
  activeMode={AppMode}
  allowedModes={AppMode[]}
  variant="expanded" | "collapsed" | "mobile"  // defaults 'expanded'
/>
```

Koda can infer `variant` from sidebar state in the expanded/collapsed case — pass via parent.

## 8. Dark mode

Segmented control dark mode:
- Container: `bg-muted/40`
- Active: `bg-background ring-1 ring-border text-foreground` OR `bg-primary/15 text-primary` — pick one and justify

Contrast: active segment must have ≥ 4.5:1 text-on-bg in both modes.

## 9. `/dev/design` Section 27

Showcase:
- ModeSwitcher expanded, all 3 states (Operate / Manage / Configure active)
- ModeSwitcher collapsed (icon stack)
- MobileNav mode tabs
- 2-mode variant (receptionist role demo)
- 1-mode hidden variant note (artist)

## 10. Acceptance

- ModeSwitcher renders 3 segments for owner, 2 for receptionist, 0 (null) for artist
- Click switches mode + `router.refresh()` updates sidebar nav groups to new mode's items
- Cookie persists across reloads
- `G O / G M / G C` chords work + no route push
- Mobile tabs work + sheet closes on change
- Collapsed sidebar shows icon-only variant

Mechanical spec — no design decisions for Koda.

1	# S16 — Clean Separation: Persona Mode Switcher + De-duplication + P1 Fix
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	S13-S15 consolidated the sidebar (31→13 items), redesigned Settings, and shipped the multi-studio switcher. Production review by the user and Sage surfaced two lingering structural problems:
6	
7	1. **Duplication.** Three destinations still live in two places each — Settings keeps a link *and* the main sidebar keeps a link (or redirect). Feels incoherent, breaks the Stripe/Linear mental model.
8	2. **"All in one SaaS" soup.** Owner sees 13 top-level items covering daily ops, weekly management, and configuration in one flat list. Even grouped, cognitive load stays high. No mental boundary between "my daily work" / "running the business" / "configuring the software."
9	
10	Two asks from the user:
11	- Separate properly (fix the duplication + split by mental mode).
12	- Evaluate an "agency / team account" concept for running multiple studios.
13	
14	Goal: make InkOS feel like **three focused apps in one shell** — Operate / Manage / Configure — with workspace (studio) switching on top. Match the Stripe pattern (Test vs Live modes + workspace picker) rather than a flat everything-sidebar.
15	
16	---
17	
18	## Decisions (locked)
19	
20	### 1. Persona Mode Switcher (primary fix)
21	
22	Sidebar top gets a 3-way segmented control or dropdown: **Operate · Manage · Configure**. Each mode has a distinct sidebar subset.
23	
24	| Mode | Items | Who defaults here |
25	|---|---|---|
26	| **Operate** (daily) | Dashboard · Calendar · Appointments · Clients · Inventory | guest_artist, artist, receptionist |
27	| **Manage** (weekly) | Team · Payments · Commissions · Payroll · Reports · Campaigns · Referrals | admin, owner |
28	| **Configure** (setup) | Settings (full hub) | — (accessed on demand) |
29	
30	Density per screen: 5 / 7 / 1 items (vs today's 13 for owner).
31	
32	**Access rules:**
33	- artist + guest_artist see Operate only (switcher hidden)
34	- receptionist sees Operate + limited Manage (Payments, Reports only — already role-gated)
35	- admin + owner see all three; switcher visible
36	- Active mode persisted in `inkos_active_mode` cookie (mirrors S15's `inkos_active_studio` pattern)
37	- Default by role on first login; user override persists
38	
39	### 2. De-duplication (tactical cleanup)
40	
41	Resolve the three confirmed duplications:
42	
43	| Feature | Keep at | Remove from | Rationale |
44	|---|---|---|---|
45	| **Booking Page** | `Settings > Studio > Booking page` | Remove from APP_NAV `Schedule` group | It's configuration, not a daily task |
46	| **Ink Registry** | `Inventory` tab (already reachable via `/inventory?tab=ink-registry`) | Remove from `SettingsSidebar` Studio group | It's operational (stock-adjacent), not config |
47	| **Roles & Permissions** | `Artists > Permissions` tab (S13 decision) | Remove from `SettingsSidebar` Team group (Sage W1) | Already redirected, orphan link is confusing |
48	
49	All three redirects in `next.config.ts` stay (preserve any deep links).
50	
51	### 3. P1 Fix — getAuthenticatedUser cookie-first
52	
53	S15 Sage review flagged: 134 API routes use `getAuthenticatedUser()` in `lib/supabase/server.ts:58-88`, which still reads `.order('created_at').limit(1).single()` against `studio_members`. The new StudioSwitcher writes a cookie, but the API layer ignores it → multi-studio users see data for studio A while the UI shows studio B.
54	
55	Fix: `getAuthenticatedUser()` reads `inkos_active_studio` cookie first, validates membership, falls back to first-membership. Single-point change, propagates to all 134 routes.
56	
57	### 4. Agency layer — **deferred to S17** (separate sprint)
58	
59	DB migration required (no `agency_id` / `organizations` table today). Concept:
60	- New `agencies` table: `id, name, slug, logo_url, owner_id, created_at`
61	- `studios.agency_id` FK, nullable
62	- Agency owner role for cross-studio dashboards (portfolio MRR, artist leaderboard, consolidated reports)
63	- `StudioSwitcher` extends to show an "Agency Portfolio" entry when `agencies.length >= 1`
64	
65	Reserved for S17 once a real agency customer is on the roadmap. Under-5% of target market for v1. S16 does not block this — cookie pattern is already in place.
66	
67	---
68	
69	## Implementation Plan
70	
71	### Part A — De-duplication + P1 fix (4h, do FIRST)
72	
73	**A1 — Remove Booking Page from main sidebar**
74	- `components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts` — drop the `Booking Page` entry from the `SCHEDULE` group
75	- `next.config.ts` — keep the `/settings/booking-page → /settings/studio/booking-page` redirect (already there from S14)
76	- Cmd+K palette still finds it (no action needed — palette indexes all routes)
77	
78	**A2 — Remove Ink Registry from SettingsSidebar Studio group**
79	- `components/settings/SettingsSidebar.tsx:41` — delete the `Ink registry` row from Studio group
80	- `next.config.ts` — keep `/settings/ink-registry → /inventory?tab=ink-registry` redirect
81	- Inventory tab remains canonical
82	
83	**A3 — Remove Roles & Permissions from SettingsSidebar Team group**
84	- `components/settings/SettingsSidebar.tsx:49` — delete the `Roles & permissions` row from Team group
85	- Redirect `/settings/team/permissions → /artists?tab=permissions` stays
86	- Sage W1 closed
87	
88	**A4 — P1 fix in getAuthenticatedUser**
89	- `lib/supabase/server.ts:58-88` — rewrite:
90	  ```ts
91	  const cookieStore = await cookies()
92	  const activeStudioId = cookieStore.get('inkos_active_studio')?.value
93	  // Fetch ALL memberships (not .limit(1))
94	  // Find one matching activeStudioId; if invalid/missing, fall back to first by created_at
95	  // Return user + resolved studioId + role
96	  ```
97	- Reuses the same resolution pattern as `lib/context/active-studio.ts` — extract into a shared `resolveActiveStudio(user)` helper if it simplifies
98	- Regression test: `tests/smoke/active-studio.spec.ts` — user with 2 memberships + cookie set to second → `/api/dashboard/kpis` returns studio B's KPIs

101	- `components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts`

108	### Part B — Persona Mode Switcher (8h)
109	
110	**B1 — Mode types + server helper**
111	
112	New file: `lib/context/active-mode.ts`:
113	```ts
114	export type AppMode = 'operate' | 'manage' | 'configure'
115	
116	export async function getActiveMode(role: NavRole): Promise<AppMode> {
117	  const cookie = (await cookies()).get('inkos_active_mode')?.value
118	  const allowed = getAllowedModes(role)
119	  if (cookie && allowed.includes(cookie as AppMode)) return cookie as AppMode
120	  return getDefaultModeForRole(role)
121	}
122	
123	export function getAllowedModes(role: NavRole): AppMode[] {
124	  if (role === 'artist' || role === 'guest_artist') return ['operate']
125	  if (role === 'receptionist') return ['operate', 'manage']
126	  return ['operate', 'manage', 'configure']  // admin, owner
127	}
128	
129	export function getDefaultModeForRole(role: NavRole): AppMode {
130	  if (role === 'artist' || role === 'guest_artist' || role === 'receptionist') return 'operate'
131	  return 'manage'  // admin, owner default to Manage (their most common landing)
132	}
133	```
134	
135	Mirrors `lib/context/active-studio.ts` pattern exactly.
136	
137	**B2 — API route for mode switching**
138	
139	New: `app/api/context/set-mode/route.ts`:
140	- POST body: `{ mode: AppMode }`
141	- Validate mode is in `getAllowedModes(role)` for current user
142	- Set `inkos_active_mode` cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure-in-prod, Path=/, 1 year)
143	- Return `{ ok: true }`
144	
145	**B3 — Restructure nav-config.ts by mode**
146	
147	`components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts` — add a `mode: AppMode` field to each group:
148	```ts
149	{ label: 'HOME', mode: 'operate', items: [...Dashboard] }
150	{ label: 'SCHEDULE', mode: 'operate', items: [...Calendar, Appointments] }
151	{ label: 'CLIENTS', mode: 'operate', items: [Clients] }
152	{ label: 'INVENTORY', mode: 'operate', items: [Inventory] }
153	
154	{ label: 'TEAM', mode: 'manage', items: [Team] }
155	{ label: 'MONEY', mode: 'manage', items: [Payments, Commissions, Payroll, Reports] }
156	{ label: 'MARKETING', mode: 'manage', items: [Campaigns, Referrals] }
157	
158	{ label: 'CONFIGURE', mode: 'configure', items: [Settings] }
159	```
160	
161	Drop the current `SETTINGS` group top-level entry (replaced by the `configure` mode).
162	
163	**B4 — AppSidebar filtering**
164	
165	`components/app/sidebar/AppSidebar.tsx` — accept `activeMode: AppMode` prop. Extend existing filter chain to also filter by `group.mode === activeMode`.
166	
167	**B5 — `<ModeSwitcher>` component**
168	
169	New: `components/shared/ModeSwitcher.tsx`:
170	- Segmented control (3 buttons: Operate / Manage / Configure)
171	- Hidden entirely for roles with only 1 allowed mode
172	- Active mode highlighted; disabled modes not rendered (artist never sees Manage button)
173	- Placement: **top of sidebar**, above the logo/studio area (or below — Vega design pass will pick)
174	- Collapsed sidebar state: icons only (Calendar / Briefcase / Settings)
175	- Click → POST `/api/context/set-mode` → `router.refresh()`
176	- Icons: `CalendarCheck` (Operate), `Briefcase` (Manage), `Cog` (Configure)
177	
178	**B6 — Layout integration**
179	
180	`app/(app)/layout.tsx`:
181	- Call `getActiveMode(role)` after `getActiveStudio()`
182	- Pass `activeMode` to `AppSidebar`
183	- Thread allowed modes so ModeSwitcher knows what to render
184	
185	**B7 — Keyboard shortcut**
186	
187	`G+O` → switch to Operate, `G+M` → Manage, `G+C` → Configure. Add to existing `G_CHORD_MAP` in `components/app/sidebar/AppHeader.tsx`. Posts to the mode API, not a route navigation.
188	
189	**B8 — MobileNav mode tabs**
190	
191	`components/shared/MobileNav.tsx` — add mode tabs at top of sheet (Operate / Manage / Configure). Same filter logic.
192	
193	**B9 — `/dev/design` Section 27**
194	
195	Preview of ModeSwitcher in all 3 states, including the collapsed-sidebar variant and MobileNav tabs.
196

198	- `lib/context/active-mode.ts` (NEW)
199	- `app/api/context/set-mode/route.ts` (NEW)

209	## Cross-cutting rules
210	
211	- Base-ui `render={<X/>}` pattern — no Radix `asChild`
212	- `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true` conditional spread
213	- 0 raw hex (only `#0a0a0f`, `#7c3aed`)
214	- 0 default Tailwind shadows

content.content: 1 # Vega Design Spec: Sprint S15 — Studio + Location Switcher 2 3 **Project:** InkOS | **Stack:** A (Next.js 16 + Supabase + Railway) | **Date:** 2026-04-17 4 **Sprint:** S15 of giggly-kindling-bee.md | **Depends on:** S13 (PlanBadge exists, PageTabs exists), S14 (Settings hub) 5 6 --- 7 8 ## Overview 9 10 S15 introduces two context-switcher components inserted into the existing `AppHeader` breadcrumb area. Single-studio users see zero change. Multi-studio users get `StudioSwitcher`; multi-location studios get `LocationSwitcher`. Active context is resolved server-side via cookies, with URL param override for deep links. 11 12 No new pages. No new routes other than two `POST` API handlers. The visible change is entirely within the `h-14` header bar that already exists. 13 14 --- 15 16 ## 1. Type Definitions 17 18 These shared types flow from `lib/context/active-studio.ts` and `lib/context/active-location.ts` to both server layout and client switcher components. 19 20 ```ts 21 // lib/context/active-studio.ts — export types inline 22 23 import type { Database } from '@/lib/supabase/types' 24 25 export type StudioRow = Database['public']['Tables']['studios']['Row'] 26 export type StudioMemberRow = Database['public']['Tables']['studio_members']['Row'] 27 export type StudioMemberRole = StudioMemberRow['role'] 28 // 'owner' | 'admin' | 'artist' | 'receptionist' | 'guest_artist' 29 30 export interface StudioMembership { 31 studioId: string 32 studio: StudioRow 33 role: StudioMemberRole 34 /** Resolved subscription plan for this studio. Defaults 'solo' if no active sub. */ 35 plan: import('@/lib/billing/feature-gate').PlanTier 36 } 37 38 export interface ActiveStudioContext { 39 studioId: string 40 studio: StudioRow 41 role: StudioMemberRole 42 plan: import('@/lib/billing/feature-gate').PlanTier 43 allMemberships: StudioMembership[] 44 } 45 ``` 46 47 ```ts 48 // lib/context/active-location.ts — export types inline 49 50 import type { Database } from '@/lib/supabase/types' 51 52 export type LocationRow = Database['public']['Tables']['locations']['Row'] 53 54 export interface ActiveLocationContext { 55 /** null means "All locations" view */ 56 locationId: string | null 57 location: LocationRow | null 58 allLocations: LocationRow[] 59 } 60 ``` 61 62 --- 63 64 ## 2. Server Helpers 65 66 ### `lib/context/active-studio.ts` 67 68 **Resolution order:** 69 1. URL search param `studio` (passed in from page search params, not directly readable in layout — read from `headers()` referer OR pass via a wrapper; see implementation note) 70 2. Cookie `inkos_active_studio` (httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Max-Age 31536000) 71 3. First membership ordered by `studio_members.created_at ASC` 72 73 **Implementation note for URL param:** `app/(app)/layout.tsx` is a server component. It can read cookies but not URL search params directly (search params are available to `page.tsx`, not `layout.tsx`). Koda must pass the studio param via a client-side bootstrap on first render, OR implement in a route handler. The simplest correct path: in `layout.tsx`, read only cookie + fallback. The URL param `?studio=X` is honoured by having the user's browser POST to `/api/context/set-studio` on page load via a tiny `` client component (see Section 6). 74 75 **Validation:** after resolving studioId from any source, confirm the user has a `studio_members` row for it. If validation fails: clear cookie, fall back to first membership. 76 77 **Pseudocode shape:** 78 ```ts 79 export async function getActiveStudio(): Promise 80 // Called in app/(app)/layout.tsx. 81 // Uses: createClient() from lib/supabase/server.ts 82 // Reads: await cookies() → inkos_active_studio value 83 // Query: SELECT all studio_members + studios join for user, ordered by created_at ASC 84 // Returns: resolved ActiveStudioContext 85 // Side effect: none (does NOT write cookie — cookie write happens in /api/context/set-studio) 86 ``` 87 88 **What replaces in layout.tsx:** the current `memberResult` Promise.all branch. The new call is: 89 ```ts 90 const activeStudio = await getActiveStudio() 91 const { studioId, studio, role, plan, allMemberships } = activeStudio 92 ``` 93 The subscription query and locationCount query stay in layout.tsx (or move inside getActiveStudio — Koda's call for colocation). 94 95 ### `lib/context/active-location.ts` 96 97 **Resolution order:** 98 1. Cookie `inkos_active_location` (httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Max-Age 31536000) 99 2. Studio's primary location (`is_primary = true`) 100 3. First location ordered by `sort_order ASC, created_at ASC` 101 4. `null` (all-locations view) 102 103 **Validation:** location must belong to the active `studioId`. If stale/invalid: clear cookie, fall back. 104 105 **"All locations" eligibility:** only `owner` and `admin` roles may select `null`. For `artist`, `receptionist`, `guest_artist`: fall back to their assigned location (query `location_artists` or equivalent join). If no assignment exists, default to first location. 106 107 ```ts 108 export async function getActiveLocation(studioId: string): Promise 109 // Reads: await cookies() → inkos_active_location value 110 // Query: SELECT all locations WHERE studio_id = studioId ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC 111 // Returns: ActiveLocationContext 112 ``` 113 114 --- 115 116 ## 3. API Routes 117 118 ### `app/api/context/set-studio/route.ts` 119 120 ``` 121 Method: POST 122 Auth: Authenticated user (createClient() — RLS applies) 123 Body: { studioId: string } 124 Zod: z.object({ studioId: z.string().uuid() }) 125 ``` 126 127 **Steps:** 128 1. Parse + validate body with Zod. Return 400 on failure. 129 2. Verify membership: `supabase.from('studio_members').select('id').eq('user_id', user.id).eq('studio_id', studioId).single()`. If no row: 403. 130 3. Set cookie `inkos_active_studio` = studioId via `cookies().set(...)` in a `NextResponse`. 131 4. Clear cookie `inkos_active_location` (set Max-Age=0 or delete). Forces fresh location resolution under the new studio. 132 5. Return `NextResponse.json({ ok: true })`. 133 134 **Cookie spec:** 135 ``` 136 Name: inkos_active_studio 137 Value: 138 HttpOnly: true 139 SameSite: Lax 140 Path: / 141 Max-Age: 31536000 (1 year) 142 Secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' 143 ``` 144 145 ### `app/api/context/set-location/route.ts` 146 147 ``` 148 Method: POST 149 Auth: Authenticated user 150 Body: { locationId: string | null } 151 Zod: z.object({ locationId: z.string().uuid().nullable() }) 152 ``` 153 154 **Steps:** 155 1. Parse + validate. 156 2. If `locationId` is non-null: verify `supabase.from('locations').select('id').eq('id', locationId).eq('studio_id', activeStudioId).single()`. Derive `activeStudioId` from cookie (not body — never trust client for studio scope). If mismatch: 403. 157 3. If `locationId` is null: verify user role is `owner` or `admin`. If not: 403. 158 4. Set cookie `inkos_active_location` = locationId (or delete if null — use Max-Age=0 for null). 159 5. Return `NextResponse.json({ ok: true })`. 160 161 **Cookie spec:** 162 ``` 163 Name: inkos_active_location 164 Value: (absent when "All locations") 165 HttpOnly: true 166 SameSite: Lax 167 Path: / 168 Max-Age: 31536000 169 Secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' 170 ``` 171 172 --- 173 174 ## 4. `` Client Component (URL deep-link support) 175 176 Path: `components/shared/StudioParamSync.tsx` 177 178 **Purpose:** reads `?studio=X` from URL on mount, fires POST to set-studio if it differs from current active studio, then calls `router.refresh()`.
